header.urlLabel: Address of the site to test
url.error.empty: Enter an address, for example https://example.com
url.error.invalid: That address doesn't look valid. Try https://example.com
url.error.unsupportedProtocol: Only http and https addresses can be tested.
url.error.localNetwork: Local network addresses (like 192.168.x.x) aren't supported in this version. You can use localhost.
sidebar.title: Devices
empty.title: Test how your site looks on any screen
empty.body: Enter an address above and select Open.
frame.title: {device} preview
frame.browserBarsEstimated: The visible height for this device is estimated.
help.toggle: Site not loading or not showing its mobile version?
help.body: Some sites (like Google, GitHub and many news sites) block being shown inside another site for security reasons. When that happens, the preview shows an error such as "refused to connect". This is the site's own setting, not a problem with ResponsiveController.
help.openWindow: Open in a new window at this size
help.note: The window matches the selected device's width. If the device is taller than your screen, the window's height is reduced to fit. If Chrome is in full screen on macOS, a new tab opens instead of a window. Exit full screen and try again. Some environments, like Claude's browser panel, also open a new tab instead of a window.
help.bodyUserAgent: Some sites (like mackolik.com) choose their mobile version based on the browser's identity rather than the screen width. These sites open in their desktop version here and in the new window. To see their mobile version, open Chrome's Developer Tools (Cmd + Option + I on macOS, F12 on Windows) and use the device toolbar.
upload.title: Upload your project
upload.dropzone: Drag and drop a file or folder here
upload.limit: Up to 50 MB. Projects that run on HTML, CSS and JavaScript are supported.
upload.folderUnsupported: This browser can't choose folders. You can upload your project as a ZIP.
upload.error.tooLarge: The project is over the 50 MB limit. Remove unneeded folders like node_modules and try again.
upload.error.fileType: Only .zip and .html files can be uploaded.
upload.error.badZip: The ZIP file couldn't be opened. Check that it isn't damaged.
upload.error.noHtml: No HTML file to open was found in this project.
upload.error.previewUnavailable: This browser isn't allowing uploaded projects to be previewed. If you're using a private window, try again in a normal window.
upload.sourceWarning: This looks like a source code project (it has package.json and src/). Build it first with npm run build and upload the dist folder.
warnings.viewport: This page has no viewport tag. Real phones draw it at desktop width and shrink it, so the preview may look different.
warnings.serverFiles: These files don't run in the browser, so these pages may look empty or broken: {files}
help.uploadHint: If it's your own project, you can upload it to test.
frame.watchAdaptation: Apple Watch draws pages 320 pixels wide and shrinks them to fit the screen.
favorites.empty: No favorites yet. Use the ☆ next to a device to add one.
favorites.dropHint: Drop here to add to frequently used
view.label: View
grid.empty: No devices in the grid. Add one from the menu or drag it here.
grid.dropHint: Drop here to add to the grid
slow.warning: The preview has slowed down. Removing a few devices from the grid may help.
scale.label: Scale
rotate.resetDone: All devices restored to their original orientation.
custom.note: Custom sizes aren't saved and are removed when the page reloads.
custom.empty: No custom sizes yet. Enter a width and height and select Create, or drag the edge of the device frame.
custom.error.range: Width and height must be between 100 and 3840 px.
fold.sideBySideDone: {device} folded and unfolded are now side by side in the grid.
shot.title: Screenshot
shot.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. This browser doesn't allow copying images to the clipboard; you can use Download.
shot.error: The screenshot couldn't be taken. Try again.
shot.reducedNote: The page is too long, so the screenshot was taken at {scale}x. Split it into parts for full resolution.
shot.partsNote: The page was split into {count} parts. Download saves them as a single ZIP file; Copy works only with a single image.
shot.webpUnsupported: This browser can't create WebP files; the image was downloaded as PNG.
shot.separateNote: Screenshots of {count} devices were taken. Download saves them as a single ZIP file.
shot.reducedSome: For some devices the page was too long, so the density was reduced; use the 📷 in that device's box for full resolution.
shot.shareUnsupported: This browser doesn't support screen sharing (e.g. iPhone and iPad). Screenshots of sites opened by URL can be taken on a computer with Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
shot.shareDenied: Screen sharing wasn't allowed. Try again and allow sharing to take the screenshot.
shot.wrongSurface: You need to share this tab to take the screenshot. Try again and choose this tab in the sharing window.
shot.screenScaleNote: The screenshot was taken at its on-screen size ({scale}%). Increase the scale and try again for a sharper image.
notes.title: Notes
notes.sessionPlaceholder: General notes about this test session…
notes.devicePlaceholder: What you noticed on this device…
notes.storage: Notes are stored only in this browser.
